meanings.usage: 指有价值的物品或财富，常与lost、buried连用
表示用仪器或感官发现或查明某事物
指仔细查看或调查某事物
指地球表面的泥土或表层土
指非常彻底地、完全地做某事
指对某事有把握、相信会成功
指使某物显露出来或让人知道

phrases.usage: 表示梦想、希望等成为现实

examples.en: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
examples.zh: 最近找到丢失宝藏的梦想几乎变成了现实。

phrases.usage: 表示尽管、虽然，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: In spite of this, many people are confident that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，许多人仍然相信'探测仪'可能会发现有价值的东西。

examples.en: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep.
examples.zh: 非常兴奋的搜寻队挖了一个两英尺深的洞。

phrases.usage: 表示确信、相信某事会发生

examples.en: Many people are confident that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value.
examples.zh: 许多人相信'探测仪'可能会发现有价值的东西。

phrases.usage: 表示被用来做某事，被用于

examples.en: The machine was used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
examples.zh: 这台机器被用来探测埋在地下黄金。

examples.en: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything.
examples.zh: 搜寻队随后彻底搜索了整个洞穴，但没有发现任何东西。

examples.en: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
examples.zh: 他们最终发现了一枚几乎毫无价值的小金币。

examples.en: A search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
examples.zh: 一支搜寻队进入洞穴，希望能找到埋藏的宝藏。

examples.en: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore.
examples.zh: 这台机器被用于海边附近的一个洞穴。

examples.en: They dug a hole two feet deep.
examples.zh: 他们挖了一个两英尺深的洞。

phrases.usage: /sɜːtʃ ˈpɑːrti/ noun phrase. 搜索队，搜寻队（指为了寻找某人或某物而组织起来的一群人）

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 过去进行时表示在过去某一时刻或某一段时间正在进行的动作 用于描述过去正在进行的动作，常与when、while等连用

examples.en: The leader was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold.
examples.zh: 队长正在检查洞口附近的土壤时，机器显示地下有黄金。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 过去完成时表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作 用于描述两个过去的动作中较早发生的动作，或某事在过去的某个时间点之前已经完成

examples.en: The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.
examples.zh: 海盗们经常把金子埋在洞穴里，然后却忘记取走。

grammar.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
grammar.structure: 主语 + be动词 + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者 当强调动作的承受者或不知道动作的执行者时使用

examples.en: A new machine called 'The Revealer' has been invented.
examples.zh: 一种名为'探测仪'的新机器被发明了。

examples.en: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore.
examples.zh: 这台机器被用于海边附近的一个洞穴。

patterns.pattern: S + has/have been + 过去分词

original.en: A new machine called 'The Revealer' has been invented.
original.zh: 一种名为'探测仪'的新机器被发明了。

imitations.en: A new museum has been built in our city.
imitations.zh: 一座新博物馆在我们的城市建成了。

imitations.en: The ancient temple has been discovered by archaeologists.
imitations.zh: 这座古庙被考古学家发现了。

patterns.pattern: S + was/were + 动词-ing + when + 主语 + 动词过去式

original.en: The leader was examining the soil when the machine showed that there was gold.
original.zh: 队长正在检查土壤时，机器显示有金子。

imitations.en: I was reading a book when the phone rang.
imitations.zh: 我正在看书时电话响了。

imitations.en: She was cooking dinner when the lights went out.
imitations.zh: 她正在做晚饭时灯灭了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 数量/尺寸 + deep/wide/tall

original.en: They dug a hole two feet deep.
original.zh: 他们挖了一个两英尺深的洞。

imitations.en: The river is about ten meters deep.
The tower is fifty meters tall.

patterns.pattern: In spite of + 名词/动名词, S + 动词

original.en: In spite of this, many people are confident that the machine may reveal something of value.
original.zh: 尽管如此，许多人仍然相信这台机器可能会发现有价值的东西。

imitations.en: In spite of the rain, we went out for a walk.
imitations.zh: 尽管下雨，我们还是出去散步了。

imitations.en: In spite of his age, he still works very hard.
imitations.zh: 尽管年纪大了，他仍然工作很努力。

lines.en: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
lines.zh: 最近，找到失踪宝藏的梦想差一点儿变成现实。

lines.en: A new machine called 'The Revealer ' has been invented and it has been used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
lines.zh: 一种叫“探宝器”的新机器已经发明出来，并被人们用来探测地下埋藏的金子。

lines.en: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where -- it is said -- pirates used to hide gold.
lines.zh: 在靠近海边的一个据说过去海盗常在里面藏金子的岩洞里，这种机器被派上了用场。

lines.en: The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.
lines.zh: 海盗们过去常把金子埋藏在那个洞里，可后来却没能取走。

lines.en: Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
lines.zh: 一支用这种新机器装备起来的探宝队进入了这个岩洞，希望找到埋藏着的金子。

lines.en: The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.
lines.zh: 当这个队的队长正在检查洞口附近的土壤时，那台机器显示出它的下面埋有金子。

lines.en: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep. They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless .
lines.zh: 队员们异常激动，就地挖了一个两英尺深的坑，但最后找到的是一枚几乎一钱不值的小金币。

lines.en: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk.
lines.zh: 队员们接着又把整个洞彻底搜寻了一遍，但除了一只空铁皮箱外什么也没找到。

lines.en: In spite of this, many people are confident that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value fairly soon.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，很多人仍然相信“探宝器”很快就会探出值钱的东西来。

questions.zh: 这支探宝队到底找到了什么？
questions.a: They found only a small gold coin which was almost worthless, and an empty tin trunk — no gold mine at all.
questions.aZh: 他们只找到一枚几乎一钱不值的小金币和一只空铁皮箱，根本没有金矿。
questions.hint: found a small gold coin which was almost worthless；did not find anything except an empty tin trunk。

questions.q: In 'where pirates used to hide gold' and 'The pirates would often bury gold in the cave', can used to and would be swapped freely?
questions.zh: used to hide 与 would often bury 都译作“过去常常”，能随意互换吗？
questions.a: No. used to can describe past repeated actions AND past states, implying the situation no longer exists; would only describes repeated past actions and never states.
questions.aZh: 不能。used to 既可表过去反复动作，也可表过去状态；would 只表过去反复的动作，不表状态。
questions.hint: 对比 where pirates used to hide gold 与 would often bury gold in the cave。

questions.q: What is the grammatical function of 'Armed with the new machine'?
questions.zh: Armed with the new machine 在句中是什么成分？
questions.a: It is a past participle phrase used as an adverbial; its logical subject is the main clause subject 'a search party', with which it has a passive relation.
questions.aZh: 它是过去分词短语作状语，表示伴随状况；其逻辑主语就是主句主语 a search party。
questions.hint: Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave。

questions.q: What does 'this' refer to in 'In spite of this', and why 'may reveal' instead of 'will reveal'?
questions.zh: In spite of this 中的 this 指代什么？为何用 may reveal？
questions.a: 'This' refers to the disappointing result that the party found nothing except an empty tin trunk. 'may' expresses possibility rather than certainty.
questions.aZh: this 指代“除了一只空铁皮箱外什么也没找到”这一结果；may 表示“有可能”的推测。

questions.q: Why is the title 'Not a gold mine' ironic?
questions.zh: 标题 Not a gold mine 的反讽妙在哪里？
questions.a: The title denies the expectation set up by 'Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true': gold was detected, but it turned out to be one nearly worthless coin, so there was no mine at all.
questions.aZh: 标题否定了首句营造的期待：金子确实探测到了，却只是一枚几乎不值钱的金币，根本没有矿。
questions.hint: 结合首句 almost came true 与末句 In spite of this。

translation:
最近，找到失踪宝藏的梦想差一点儿变成现实。
一种叫“探宝器”的新机器已经发明出来，并被人们用来探测地下埋藏的金子。
在靠近海边的一个据说过去海盗常在里面藏金子的岩洞里，这种机器被派上了用场。
海盗们过去常把金子埋藏在那个洞里，可后来却没能取走。
一支用这种新机器装备起来的探宝队进入了这个岩洞，希望找到埋藏着的金子。
当这个队的队长正在检查洞口附近的土壤时，那台机器显示出它的下面埋有金子。
队员们异常激动，就地挖了一个两英尺深的坑，但最后找到的是一枚几乎一钱不值的小金币。
队员们接着又把整个洞彻底搜寻了一遍，但除了一只空铁皮箱外什么也没找到。
尽管如此，很多人仍然相信“探宝器”很快就会探出值钱的东西来。
title: Not a gold mine
subtitle: 并非金矿

lead.question: 探宝器真能在海边岩洞里探出金矿吗？标题“并非金矿”藏着什么反讽？
lead.warmup: 每个人都做过暴富的梦：藏宝图、荒凉的海边岩洞、销声匿迹的海盗。如今“梦想成真”有了技术加持——一台叫“探宝器”的新机器被发明出来，专门探测埋在地下的金子。一支装备精良的探宝队走进岩洞，机器显示土壤下有金子！他们激动地挖了两英尺深……结果如何？标题早已剧透。
goals: 听懂并复述课文情节：探宝器、海边岩洞、两英尺深的坑、空铁皮箱
辨析 used to 与 would 表过去习惯的分工
掌握 Armed with 分词短语作状语、be confident that、in spite of 等结构
理解标题 Not a gold mine 的反讽：找到金子不等于找到金矿
lead.summary: 装备“探宝器”的探宝队在据说海盗藏过金的海边岩洞里寻宝：机器显示地下有金子，可挖了两英尺深，只找到一枚几乎不值钱的金币，搜遍全洞也只得一只空铁皮箱，恰扣标题 Not a gold mine 的反讽。语言重点是 used to 与 would、Armed with 分词状语。
lead.tips: used to 既可表过去状态也可表反复动作且暗含“今非昔比”，would 只表反复动作、不表状态；armed with 分词短语的逻辑主语必须是主句主语。

exercises.q: 根据汉语提示填空：Dreams of finding lost treasure almost ______ ______ recently.
用括号内动词的适当形式填空：A new machine ______ (call) 'The Revealer' has been invented and it has been used to ______ (detect) gold which has been ______ (bury) in the ground.
用 used to 或 would 填空：Pirates ______ hide gold in the cave, and they ______ often bury it there and then fail to collect it.
exercises.note: would 表反复动作，不表状态。

exercises.q: 把过去分词短语还原为状语从句：Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
exercises.a: After the search party had been armed with the new machine, they went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
exercises.note: 分词逻辑主语须与主句主语一致。

exercises.q: 用括号内动词的正确时态填空：The leader of the party ______ (examine) the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine ______ (show) that there was gold under the ground.

选词填空（seashore / soil / entrance / thoroughly / worthless / trunk）：The cave is near the ______. The leader examined the ______ near the ______ to the cave. The party searched the whole cave ______ but found only a ______ gold coin and an empty tin ______.
exercises.a: seashore; soil; entrance; thoroughly; worthless; trunk

exercises.q: 汉译英：尽管如此，很多人仍然相信“探宝器”很快就会探出值钱的东西来。
exercises.a: In spite of this, many people are confident that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value fairly soon.
exercises.note: in spite of 后接 this。

quiz.q: 课文中被称为 'The Revealer' 的是什么？
options: A pirate who once hid gold in the cave
A new machine invented to detect buried gold
The leader of the search party
An empty tin trunk found in the cave

quiz.q: 下列哪一句正确表达“海盗过去常把金子埋在那个洞里”？
options: The pirates used to burying gold in the cave.
The pirates are used to bury gold in the cave.
The pirates would often bury gold in the cave.
The pirates would often buried gold in the cave.

quiz.q: 'Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave.' 中 Armed with 的作用是？
options: 现在分词短语，作 machine 的后置定语
过去分词短语作状语，说明探宝队的装备状况
谓语动词的被动语态形式
介词短语，在句中作表语
quiz.note: be armed with 与主语构成被动关系。

quiz.q: 课文中 'was examining ... when the machine showed ...' 前半句为什么用过去进行时？
options: 表示在 showed 之前已经完成的动作
表示说话此刻正在进行的动作
表示过去经常发生的习惯性动作
表示被 when 引出的短动作打断的、正在进行的背景动作

quiz.q: 探宝队挖了两英尺深的坑后，最终找到的是什么？
options: An empty tin trunk
A large amount of hidden gold
A small gold coin which was almost worthless
A map left by the pirates
quiz.note: a small gold coin which was almost worthless。

quiz.q: 末句 'In spite of this' 中的 this 指代什么？
options: The party found nothing but an empty tin trunk
The invention of the new machine
The pirates' habit of hiding gold
The leader's examination of the soil
quiz.note: this 回指上一句一无所获的结果。
